name: Full Service
source:
Welcome to Full Service! You play as Tomoki Nakamoto, a workaholic young adult who works at Schwarz Bank. Average in every way and bordering on anti-social, Tomoki isn't that great with people... However, after a chance encounter and getting a bonus at work he finds himself entangled in the lives of those at Full Service Spa! What exciting things will Tomoki experience this time?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/516439480/full-service-bl-yaoi-gay-game-dating-sim-visual-no/description]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Full Service！你将扮演在Schwarz银行工作的年轻工作狂Tomoki Nakamoto。他各方面都很普通，甚至有些不善交际……然而，一次偶遇以及工作上的奖金，让他意外卷入了Full Service水疗会所人们的生活！这一次，Tomoki会经历怎样令人兴奋的故事？

（来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/516439480/full-service-bl-yaoi-gay-game-dating-sim-visual-no/description]Kickstarter众筹活动[/url]）
